message:
We all know that feeling when the unexpected pops up, right? While we can’t predict every little twist life throws our way, we can certainly prepare for them! 🌟 The folks at Ready.gov have put together a treasure trove of resources to help us create a solid plan for our families. From communication strategies to emergency contacts, it’s a great way to feel gloriously over-prepared and ready for anything. 

Let’s take a moment to breathe and think about how we can be there for each other when it matters most. What’s one small step we can take today to feel a little more ready? 😊
